software_class: analysis assistant over datasets, metrics, and queryable business data

options.name: Notebook-centered assistant
options.when_to_use: Exploratory analysis and reproducibility are central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when non-technical users need a product UI.
options.tradeoffs: Less polished for recurring business workflows.

options.name: Text-to-query layer
options.when_to_use: Users need natural language access to governed data.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when schema ambiguity is high and governance is absent.
options.rationale: Improves access while preserving query review.
options.tradeoffs: Needs schema metadata and safety checks.
options.risks: Generated queries can be wrong with confidence.

options.name: Analytics application
options.when_to_use: Recurring analysis needs a controlled interface.
options.risks: Metric drift can occur without governance.
